en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph depicting a panoramic view of a small European town, with a mixture of residential buildings, church towers, and several tall industrial chimneys. In the foreground, there is a fenced garden or orchard area, and in the background, rolling hills or fields can be seen. The text 'Döbeln i. Sa.' appears at the top left corner of the postcard.
